title: Ballot commitment body
description: A voter's committed approval ballot (register row DK1743; spec-delta S1596): `commitment` is `sha256:` of `ballot|<election>|<salt>|<approved candidate DIDs sorted, comma-joined>`. Inside the voting window, one for each voter with standing. Nobody sees a lead while it is open; the reveal comes after the window. Chain: none (prev is null).
